blocks.title: Governed evidence boundary
blocks.text: The report preserves the returned subject identity, benchmark mapping, observation window, units, methods, coverage status and request provenance [S1]. Missing performance, correlation, capture, simulation or regime fields remain unavailable. No local statistics, substitutions, rankings or neutral defaults are introduced.

blocks.title: Decision-use boundary
blocks.text: Typed unavailability limits the conclusion and drives the insufficient signal where most required slots are absent [S1]. The evidence supports follow-up collection only; operational diligence and committee decisions remain separate handoffs with their own governed evidence and validation contracts. Every unresolved field remains reader-visible in the delivered report.
